blocks.text: Singer-actress Karylle Tatlonghari opened up about the persistent societal expectations placed on women regarding marriage and motherhood, firmly rejecting the idea that a woman’s worth is diminished by her personal life choices. During the media conference for the unscripted series “Manila Matriarchs” held in Taguig City on Monday, November 9, the “It’s Showtime” host addressed the pressure she receives from online commenters and public expectations.
